visual_personality: Surgical restraint. Near-white (#fafaf8) backgrounds, near-black (#111110) type. The site is confident in silence — it lets the work speak. Think high-end editorial design magazine.
typography_system: Cormorant Garamond for all display headings (light/300 weight, italic variants for emphasis). Inter for all body text (300–500 weight range). The contrast between the baroque serif and the neutral sans creates editorial tension. Heading sizes are large — clamp(3rem, 6vw, 5.5rem) for page titles. Line-height on headings: 1.05. Body: 1.6–1.8.
color_philosophy: Monochromatic with warm undertones. No brand color in the traditional sense — the 'primary' is near-black (var(--color-ink): #111110). Background alternates between off-white (#fafaf8) and warm grey (#f4f3ef). Dark sections use var(--color-ink) for full contrast. No gradients anywhere.
spacing_philosophy: Extremely generous. Section padding at clamp(6rem, 10vw, 9rem). Internal gaps 12–16 units. The site breathes. Cramped = wrong. When in doubt, add more space.
layout_patterns: Featured projects use full-bleed alternating split (image left/right, content panel opposite). Portfolio uses a 2-column grid on desktop. Text sections use a 12-column grid with content in cols 5–11 for asymmetric pull-quotes. Hero: full-height, text bottom-aligned, bottom-padding heavy, vertical scroll indicator.
component_vocabulary: No cards with shadows or borders. Content panels use background color difference (bg vs bg-alt vs ink) instead of borders/shadows. Project image hover: subtle scale (1.03–1.04) + dark overlay opacity. Typography links use border-bottom underline pattern, no text-decoration. Buttons are text links with underline — never filled/outlined buttons.
nav_design: Wordmark left (Cormorant Garamond, light weight). Links right (uppercase, 0.08em tracking, xs size). No CTA button in nav — refined restraint. Sticky with border-bottom. Mobile: full-screen dark overlay with giant Cormorant headings.
anti_patterns: No gradients (background or text). No rounded corners on images. No box-shadows on cards. No filled/pill buttons. No decorative icons beyond functional ones. No stock photo warmth — images should be architectural, editorial, minimal.
image_direction: Architecture, interiors, abstract minimal, editorial. Cool-light or warm-neutral tones. Consistent aspect ratio (square for grid, 4:3 or 4:5 for featured). Images are always full-bleed within their containers — no padding around images.
reveal_animation: Long easing (0.9s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)), 24px Y travel. Deliberate and slow — this is a premium studio, not a tech startup. Stagger delay: 80ms increments.
